description: Attach up to 5 files to a work item, as the Console's Files panel does: images, PDF, text, logs, Markdown, CSV, JSON, XML, HTML pages, zip, Office documents and MP4/WebM/MOV video. SVG and other types are refused. Give each file exactly one of: text (the content as a string), contentBase64 (the bytes, base64-encoded) or path (a local file, stdio server only); name is required with text or contentBase64. Files start internal (not shared with the client). All or nothing: one refused file attaches none. One call carries at most 10 MB of request, which is about 7 MB of files once base64-encoded; for a larger file use anyforge_start_file_upload (up to 1 GB). A file already on the item with the same name and size is not attached again: it comes back with alreadyAttached: true. A same-name file of another size is refused (file_name_exists) unless onNameConflict is "keep_both". Give originalCreatedAt to keep the date a file was created in another tool. Requires the write scope and a key owner who is an editor or above. Returns { files } with each file's id. Pass an idempotencyKey to retry safely: a repeat with the same key and files returns the stored files ({ replayed: true }). Only call when the person asked to attach these files.

contentBase64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded (no data: prefix).

mediaType.description: Optional media type. The extension wins when the two disagree.

name.description: The file name with its extension, which decides the stored type, for example trace.log. Optional with path (defaults to the file's own name).

originalCreatedAt.description: Optional. When the file was created in the tool it came from: an ISO 8601 date or a date and time with a zone, e.g. 2024-03-01T10:22:33.000+0000. Kept beside the upload time.

path.description: A local file path. Stdio server only.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 8-64 letters, digits, "_" or "-". A repeat with the same key and files attaches nothing new; the same key with other files is refused.

onNameConflict.description: A same-name file of a different size already on the item: refuse it (default) or attach both. A same-name, same-size file is never attached twice.

name: anyforge_add_work_item_files
title: Add work item files
